# Moltis

> Canonical machine-readable instructions for agents integrating with moltis.org.

## Install Discovery

- Root install manifest: `https://moltis.org/.well-known/moltis-install.json`
- Stable channel pointer: `https://moltis.org/.well-known/moltis-install/channels/stable.json`
- Per-release manifest: `https://moltis.org/.well-known/moltis-install/releases/{version}.json`

## Install Command

- Script: `curl -fsSL https://www.moltis.org/install.sh | sh`

## OpenClaw Import

After install, if OpenClaw data is present:

- Detect: `moltis import detect --json`
- Import all: `moltis import all --json`

## Start and Handoff

- Start gateway: `moltis gateway --bind 0.0.0.0 --port 13131`
- Healthcheck: `http://127.0.0.1:13131/api/gon`
- User handoff text: `Moltis is ready. Please visit http://<host>:13131 to complete setup.`

## Release Maintenance (for maintainers)

Generate and rotate channel/release manifests on each release:

```bash
node scripts/generate-install-release-manifest.mjs \
  --version 0.9.11 \
  --checksums-file /path/to/release-checksums.txt
```

This writes:

- `/.well-known/moltis-install/releases/<version>.json`
- `/.well-known/moltis-install/channels/stable.json`

## Discovery

- Agent card: `https://moltis.org/.well-known/agent-card.json`
- API catalog: `https://moltis.org/.well-known/api-catalog`
- Docs: `https://docs.moltis.org`
- Source: `https://github.com/moltis-org/moltis`

## Safety Expectations for Agents

- Ask for user approval before running networked install commands.
- Ask for user approval before any command requiring privilege escalation.
- Prefer `--json` command modes when available and surface failures verbatim.
